Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated: initial sizing ask and timeline constraints

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — EdgeSoft is excited about the performance gains we saw. Before we finalize comms and signatures, legal asked for a bit more color on the dedicated sizing plan and an agreed cutover window. Two asks from our side: 

1) A compact sizing matrix that maps committed RPS / concurrent chats to GPU count (we need something we can sign off on and share with our infra team).
2) A proposed cutover weekend (we are targeting late October) plus a short rollback plan if latency spikes.

I've attached our product requirements snapshot (EdgeSoft_requirements_v2.pdf) and flagged expected peak concurrency at 2,500 chat sessions with average 180 tokens/responses, burst to 5k RPS for short periods. Budget constraint: our procurement team is targeting contract signature by Oct 18 so we need acceptance criteria and a draft Mutual Action Plan no later than Oct 12.

Can you confirm whether you can run a sizing validation (real traffic replay + KV cache warm) and give a tentative resource allocation?

-Neal

Neal — thanks for the clear ask and the requirements doc. Happy to run the sizing validation and produce the matrix you can attach to procurement. Quick outline / proposed next steps: 

- We will run a 48-hour validation harness that includes: replay of a 24h production trace you share (anonymized), synthetic burst tests to 5k RPS, and KV warm runs for typical session prefixes.
- Acceptance gates: 95th pct latency < 250ms at target concurrency; no more than 1.5x hosted cost per token at steady state (post-cache); no data loss during failover test.
- Tentative resource allocation (prelim): 12 x A100 equiv GPUs (or 18 x T4-class for cost-tilt) for validation cluster. Final allocation will depend on trace QPS & seq len distribution.
- Cutover window: propose Oct 23-24 (Sat-Sun) with a canary shift of 5% on Sat 04:00 PT, ramp to 100% by Sat 12:00 PT if metrics green. Fallback plan: immediate rollback to hosted routing with preserved prefix cache; documented failback takes ~30–45 minutes.

Can you confirm: 1) you can provide a sanitized 24h trace by EOD Oct 7, and 2) acceptance of the Oct 23-24 window? I will attach a draft MAP (mutual action plan) and the sizing spreadsheet after alignment with engineering.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Hi all — technical outline for the sizing validation and the cutover playbook (high level):

Sizing validation plan (deliverable: sizing_matrix.csv + perf report)
- Inputs we need from EdgeSoft: anonymized 24h traffic trace (request timestamps, token lengths, session ids), typical prompt prefix snapshot (to exercise cache), and a list of top-50 intents to seed evals.
- Workload model: steady-state 2,500 concurrent sessions; mean response length 180 tokens; median request inter-arrival 1.2s; bursts to 5k RPS for up to 10 minutes.
- Validation cluster: 16 x A100-80GB (or equivalent) in chroma quantized profile for cost-latency balance. Expect baseline throughput ~1.2M tokens/min per 4-gpu pod under prefix warm conditions.
- Acceptance gates (final): 95p latency <250ms, error rate <0.2% (client-visible errors), prefix-hit ratio >60% after warm phase.

Cutover playbook (deliverable: cutover-runbook.md + rollback checklist)
- Canary step (5%): 04:00 PT Sat — monitor latency, token errors, token cost; 1.5h hold.
- Ramp steps: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks at each step (10–30m hold windows).
- Rollback: immediate route to hosted API, mark dedicated nodes as cordoned, preserve KV cache snapshot to attempt fast re-warm on next attempt. Estimated time-to-rollback 30–45 minutes.

Notes / risk mitigations:
- KV cache warm is a gating factor — we will run a parallel warm replay to pre-populate hot prefixes before canary.
- If the validation shows >20% delta from our preliminary numbers, we will propose a second, shorter validation pass to rebaseline.

I'll prepare the sizing_matrix.csv after we ingest the trace. We can also run a short synthetic overnight test (10% of traffic) as an early sanity check if you want confirmation before the full 48-hour run.

-Laura
Staff Engineer, Runtime — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
